notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Starting (6)': Mindful Of The Future, Security Control, Tatooine: City Outskirts, Tatooine: Watto's Junkyard, Credits Will Do Fine and The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone / We'll Need A New One; these count toward the 60. Two Effects start, so no single starting Effect is singled out.

The description and strategy say this is an 'Episode 1 only' deck for 'Ep.1 Closed Environment Tournaments' (Episode I-only environment); format left as set — Bill to decide. The Coruscant-set printings are used for Tatooine, Sense, Alter and Control.

Posted 'The Hyperdrive Generators Gone / We Need A New One' dested The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone / We'll Need A New One; 'Tatooine Wattos Junkyard' dested the Light Coruscant site Tatooine: Watto's Junkyard (the draft had the Dark page).

Posted 'Yaura' dested Yarua; 'Panakas Blaster' dested Panaka's Blaster; 'Anikins Podracer' dested Anakin's Podracer; 'A Tragedy Has Occured' dested A Tragedy Has Occurred; 'Stay Here, Where Its Safe' dested Stay Here, Where It's Safe. Mace Windu is the Coruscant card; Qui-Gon Jinn is the Tatooine card.
The post says the deck is undefeated in playtesting; no tournament is named. The same author later posted a related THGG list as 'You mean we only had 1 Only 1' (DeckTech 19114).
